## Overview

This stainless kitchen faucet offers flexible functionality with a pull-down spray head and a high-arc spout. Perfect for rinsing, filling, and cleaning, it blends ergonomic performance with a stylish finish to match any kitchen.

- FULL-RANGE, FLEXIBLE REACH: High-arc kitchen faucet swivels 360° with a 20-inch retractable hose for easier cleaning, filling and rinsing around the sink

- MAGNETIC DOCKING SPRAYER: MagnaTite Docking uses a powerful magnet to keep your pull-down kitchen faucet sprayer securely in place and prevent drooping over time

- LEAD-FREE COMPLIANT: Not all faucets are certified to necessary safety standards - Delta goes above and beyond with product testing and quality to ensure each faucet meets plumbing safety standards, including NSF/ANSI 61 and 372

- LASTS 2X LONGER: Patented DIAMOND Seal Technology reduces leak points and lasts 2X as long as the industry standard for long-lasting, leak-free performance (Industry standard based on ASME A112.18.1 of 500,000 cycles)

- LEAK-FREE SUPPLY LINES YOU CAN TRUST: Delta PEX supply lines are tested to withstand 20% more extreme pressure for 1,000 hours without leaking—far beyond plumbing standards

- EASY INSTALLATION OPTIONS: This kitchen sink faucet fits 1 or 3-hole 8-in center configurations and includes integrated InnoFlex PEX supply lines for a quicker setup - Optional deck plate included

- CORROSION-RESISTANT FINISH: Brilliance finishes are engineered for durability and tested for corrosion resistance to at least 2 times industry standards

- QUICK-CLEAN SPRAY HOLES: Touch-Clean spray holes let you easily wipe away calcium and lime buildup with the touch of a finger

- ADA-COMPLIANT DESIGN: ADA-compliant lever handle makes this kitchen faucet easy to adjust water temperature and volume

CA Residents: Prop 65 Warning(s)
